prompt:
A flat vector-style sports club crest, drawn as clean solid shapes.

Outline: a shield with a flat top and a deep V bottom.
Inside it: a vertical stack of chevrons pointing up, and the stack has THREE parts and no more: part one is a solid chevron, part two is an outlined chevron below it, part three is an outlined chevron below that. Count them — three. Every chevron ends well short of the shield border on both sides, with clear white space between the chevron tips and the border. Abstract, no animal, no letters.
Colours: #8E2C6B and #FFFFFF only, plus white.

Hard requirements:
- Absolutely NO text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no monogram, no banner or ribbon
  for a name. The mark alone.
- Flat solid colour with hard edges. No gradients, no gloss, no bevel, no drop shadow,
  no 3D, no photographic texture, no mockup on a garment.
- Centred on a plain pure white background, with even margin around it.
- Bold and simple enough to still read as itself at 40 px wide.
- Square image.
